name: Alonzo J. Edgerton
mentions: Chief Justice Edgerton sends his resignation to Washington and will enter the senatorial race against Judge Moody of Deadwood. To a man up a tree this looks as though Judge Edgerton had abando…

…of southern Dakota met at Huron on Monday. Govenor Mellette sent in his message Tuesday and Judges Moody and Edgerton were elected senators. We wonder if anything will finally come of what all in the north think is a gigantic farce.
